name: Lanna Resources Public Company Limited
summary: Lanna Resources Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufacture and distributes coal. It operates through three segments: Domestic Coal, Overseas Coal, and Ethanol Division. The company also purchases and sells coal; produces and distributes ethanol, and soil amendment substances; and generates and distributes power. In addition, it is involved in wood pellet production and distribution; and renewable energy, coal trading, and ocean freight transport businesses. It operates in Thailand, India, Singapore, Indonesia, the United Arab Emirates, and China. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
